name: NSW Regional and Remote Mental Health Scholarship
summary: Up to $3,000 for regional human services workers studying a Certificate IV in Mental Health at TAFE NSW.
key: Three scholarships each valued at up to $3,000.
who: Studying the Certificate IV in Mental Health (CHC43315) or Mental Health Peer Work (CHC43515) at TAFE NSW.
Worked or volunteered in a human services role in a rural or regional area.
No TAFE NSW, ITSA or Hunter TAFE Foundation scholarship in the last 12 months.
how: Apply through the TAFE NSW scholarships platform via the Apply now button.

source.label: TAFE NSW: NSW Regional and Remote Mental Health Scholarship

evidence.quote: Applications for the NSW Regional and Remote Mental Health Scholarship close 5 pm (AEDT) Friday, 30 October 2026.
